paper.title_en: Horizon-regular cross-focusing and inner-horizon obstructions in spherical f(R) gravity
paper.abstract_en: We formulate a horizon-regular double-null criterion for regular inner marginal horizons in spherically symmetric metric $f(R)$ gravity. Using normalized outgoing and ingoing radial null vectors $\ell^μ$ and $n^μ$, with $n^μ$ affinely parametrized, we derive an exact evolution law for the area-weighted outgoing expansion $r^2θ_{(\ell)}$. Its source is controlled by the scalaron $F\equiv f_R>0$ and by a mixed quantity $\mathcal{P}_{\ell n}$ containing matter, scalaron derivatives, and the curvature potential. If $\mathcal{P}_{\ell n}\leq F/r^2$ along a regular ingoing null segment issuing from a nondegenerate future outer marginal sphere, then the outgoing expansion cannot return to zero, and no second regular marginal sphere of the same family can occur on that generator. Conversely, a nondegenerate future inner marginal sphere requires the reverse inequality, so an outer--inner pair necessarily entails a source reversal and an exact integral balance. No trapped-region assumption is required. In the static limit, the criterion reduces to a horizon-regular relation involving the radial derivative of the metric function and remains valid in the degenerate case under the stated regularity conditions. It reproduces the Reissner--Nordström classification and is verified in an exact charged, nonconstant-curvature $f(R)$ black hole with a nonconstant scalaron. The resulting Cauchy-horizon statement is conditional and applies only when the candidate boundary is also a regular nondegenerate future inner marginal horizon.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文专注于f(R)引力中的内视界和柯西视界，属于广义相对论基础领域，理论深度高，方法新颖，表述清晰，适合推荐。
decision.title_zh: 球对称f(R)引力中视界规则的交叉聚焦与内视界障碍
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在球对称度规$f(R)$引力中为一个正则内边缘视界制定了一个视界规则的双零判据。利用归一化的出射和入射径向零矢量$\ell^μ$和$n^μ$（其中$n^μ$是仿射参数化的），我们推导出了面积加权的出射膨胀$r^2θ_{(\ell)}$的精确演化定律。其源由标量场$F\equiv f_R>0$以及一个包含物质、标量场导数和曲率势的混合量$\mathcal{P}_{\ell n}$控制。如果沿着从非退化未来外边缘球面发出的正则入射零段有$\mathcal{P}_{\ell n}\leq F/r^2$，那么出射膨胀不能恢复到零，并且在该生成元上不能出现同一族的第二个正则边缘球面。反之，非退化未来内边缘球面需要相反的不等式，因此外-内对必然导致源反转和精确的积分平衡。不需要陷阱区域假设。在静态极限中，该判据简化为涉及度规函数径向导数的视界规则关系，并且在所述正则性条件下对退化情形仍然有效。它再现了Reissner-Nordström分类，并在一个具有非恒定标量场的精确带电、非恒定曲率$f(R)$黑洞中得到验证。所得柯西视界陈述是条件性的，并且仅当候选边界也是正则非退化未来内边缘视界时才适用。
